title: Peters Delivers Commencement Address at Michigan State University
description: U.S. Senator Gary Peters delivered the Master’s and Educational Specialist degree commencement address at Michigan State University TODAY, Friday, December 17th at 11:30 AM. Peters – who earned a M.A. in Philosophy with a specialization in ethics and development from MSU – will highlight the resilience demonstrated by the graduating class throughout the pandemic and speak to the promise each graduate’s future holds entering a new frontier of discovery and innovation with a world class education in hand.
